publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper proposes an emotion-based interactive user device and user interface to enhance energy efficiency and service quality in home energy management system. We implemented our system in a test bed, and conducted some experiments. The reduction of average energy and time is 14.19% and 12% respectively.

articleTitle: Gaze location prediction in broadcast football video
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In this work we investigate gaze location prediction for the context of broadcast football video. We use Bayesian integration to combine bottom up (color, intensity, orientation, motion, novelty) and top down (ball) features. 70% success rate is obtained for CIF.

articleTitle: Blind configuration of multi-view video coding
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper introduces a self-configurable multi-view video coder (MVC) that blindly estimates the MVC group of pictures prediction structure and its stream coding order. The proposed MVC does not require prior knowledge of the geometric arrangements of video cameras or their stream properties. It is robust to camera failures and channel errors.

articleTitle: Live and time-shifted content delivery for dynamic broadcast: Terminal aspects
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In Dynamic Broadcast it is assumed that user terminals provide an interface to both a broadcast network and a broadband network. In addition, they are expected to be equipped with a storage device. The user terminals are capable of composing linear TV services of individual content items, which are either being received live via the broadcast or the broadband network or which are played back from a local storage device if they have been received before. Multiple content delivery mechanisms are supported, including live- and pre-transmission of TV programs. Inside the user terminals, a combined usage of one or more broadcast tuners, the broadband interface, and the local storage device is therefore required. In this paper, we discuss how the interaction of these devices can be managed in order to allow for the live and time-shifted delivery of TV content via dynamically changing distribution channels. Further, a demonstrator of a user terminal is presented, which allows the interruption-free presentation of TV services in a Dynamic Broadcast environment, where live as well as time-shifted content delivery mechanisms are in use.

articleTitle: Adaptive spatial/temporal direct mode selection algorithm on H.264/AVC Encoder
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper proposes an adaptive spatial/temporal direct mode selection algorithm for H.264/AVC encoders. The proposed algorithm utilizes motion information such as mb_type and motion vectors originally produced from encoders so that almost no additional computation cost is needed. Simulation results show the proposed algorithm successfully selects the appropriate direct mode for various kinds of sequences and improves compression efficiency.

articleTitle: Low-power video decoding system using a reconfigurable processor
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: A reconfigurable processor based video decoding system with bistream decoding instruction and memory processing co-processor is presented. Experimental results show that the performance is enhanced about 42% than processor only system. We also estimate that the power consumption is lower than the hardware system about 24% at SD resolution.

articleTitle: A simple, high performance edge-adaptive deinterlacing algorithm with very low complexity
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: Using a method called `Edge Slope Tracing,' this paper suggests a high performance edge-adaptive deinterlacing algorithm that can be implemented with very low complexity. To improve the accuracy of edge slope tracing, slope judgment is bi-directionally applied.

articleTitle: Multi-device Single Sign-on for cloud service continuity
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: The great variety of consumer electronic devices with support of wireless communications combined with the emerging Cloud Computing paradigm is paving the way to real anytime/anywhere computing. In this context, many services, such as music or video streaming, are delivered to the clients using Cloud-based providers. However, service continuity when moving across different terminals is still a major challenge. This paper proposes a novel middleware architecture that allows security sessions initiated from one device to be seamlessly transferred to a second one, as might be desirable in the enjoyment of long running media.<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>

articleTitle: Systematic analysis of the decoding delay on MVC decoders
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: We present a framework for the analysis of the decoding delay and communication latency in Multiview Video Coding. The application of this framework on MVC decoders allows minimizing the overall delay in immersive video-conference systems<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>.

articleTitle: Blur-free high-sensitivity imaging system utilizing combined long/short exposure green pixels
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In previous work, we have proposed a high-sensitivity imaging system based on the long exposure for all the G(green) pixels, in which the inherent blur was suppressed with using both the regularization method and motion information from blur-free short-term exposed information from R(red) / B(blue) pixels. However this method was ineffective if detected motion information is inaccurate. As a result, an inadequate accuracy of motion information lost image quality and caused blur image. In this study, we propose a new high-sensitivity imaging system that is stable under such a condition. We arrange long- and short-term exposed G pixels for each line alternatively. With combining regularization method and blur-free G pixel information obtained from the short-term exposure, the proposed system does not require motion information. Then reconstruction images of our proposed system include no blur even if accurate motion detection is difficult.

articleTitle: Hardware engine for real-time pen tracking on electrophoretic displays
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a hardware engine that performs real-time pixel interpolation and fast drives the plotted pixels to the black state for the electropheretic display. The experimental results show that the engine can finish the evaluation of pixel interpolation in 2 ms, such that the latency of pen tracking is much shorter than the previous approaches with software control schemes.

articleTitle: Personal multi-angle media broadcasting service system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a personal multi-angle media broadcasting service system. The proposed system accepts multiple input streams from the internet, files, and live broadcasts, and provides a personal media broadcast stream for clients. A personal media producer program and client programs of the proposed system are implemented on various platforms. The implemented system is experimented on a real sports event for a live broadcast of multi-angle media.

articleTitle: Cycle-accurate deterministic multithreading for multicore debugging and reliability
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: One of the key challenges in developing applications for multicore systems is dealing with the nondeterministic behavior of applications. This makes parallel programming hard and programmers should spend substantial amounts of time to debug their application. To remove the nondeterministic behavior of applications, we could make the behavior of applications deterministic through the control of thread's execution order based on their progress. To guarantee the deterministic behavior of a thread, the measured progress of a thread should be repeatable and cycle-accurate. If the progress does not meet these requirements, it is impossible to guarantee the deterministic behavior of threads. In this paper, we propose a novel method to measure a cycle-accurate deterministic progress of a thread and a technique to guarantee the deterministic behavior of applications with the proposed method. As a case study, we implement 24 video decoders on a quad core system using the proposed technique and evaluate our technique on SPLASH-2 benchmark. The experimental result yields a geometric mean of overhead of about 7.2% on SPLASH-2 benchmark.

articleTitle: A novel color restoration method using color projection
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: The representative method of color enhancement is the retinex based on human visual model. Although low contrast images are enhanced by the retinex, there exists color shifting problem that color tone change. In order to overcome the color shifting problem, a color restoration has been proposed. To this end, we propose a novel color restoration method using color projection technique. The proposed method consists of two steps. In the first step, an input image with low contrast is enhanced by a multi-scale retinex method. In the final step, by projecting each pixel of the enhanced image into the corresponding one of the input image, color restoration is performed. In experimental results, the proposed method has shown better performances of color restoration, compared with the existing method.

articleTitle: Interleaving local and remote visualization for the energy aware delivery of interactive 3D graphics on mobile devices
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In this work, the energy cost for 3D graphics processing on consumer devices is analyzed, and a framework mixing local and remote visualization techniques to trade off between rendering performances and power saving is proposed.

articleTitle: MVC real-time video encoder for full-HDTV 3D video
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: 3D video technologies such as 3D cameras, displays, and video-processing have become more important for achieving high quality and immersive video services. We propose an H.264 MVC encoder architecture for real-time 3D video distribution and transmission. We also present the first-ever successful development of a full-HDTV real-time MVC encoder.

articleTitle: An analytical study of energy consumption in Dynamic Broadcast
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: Based on a model characterizing the probability that a user (group) watches specific media content, the overall energy consumption of the distribution networks and terminal devices in Dynamic Broadcast is studied. Utilizing multiple media delivery networks and content storage devices in the user terminals the total energy required for media content delivery can be reduced compared to the energy need for traditional broadcast delivery.

articleTitle: Exploring the use of web-based video in consumer networks
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper suggests a new ontology approach to search for the targeted contents easily including the several technical issues as well as the related standard status.

articleTitle: Media quality control scheme for device collaboration service in home networks
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In home networks, the device collaboration service has challenging issues to provide QoS (Quality of Service) for its users with heterogeneous consumer electronic devices. However, existing schemes do not guarantee quality of multimedia contents. To cope with these problems, this paper presents a simple but effective media quality control scheme that can improve quality of collaborative streaming-based media contents. The proposed scheme controls collaboration contents according to the number of available collaboration devices at home and media quality based on available network bandwidth. The experimental result shows that the proposed scheme can significantly improve user-perceived quality.

articleTitle: Adaptive background generation for automatic detection of initial object region in multiple color-filter aperture camera-based surveillance system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In this paper, we present an adaptive background generation method for automatic selection of initial object region for simultaneous object detection and depth estimation using the MCA camera. We then estimate color shifting vectors (CSVs) of the extracted object's region using simplified elastic registration algorithm in the pyramid-based multi-resolution framework. Using the color shifting property of the MCA camera, the depth of the object's region is estimated from CSVs. The proposed method uses only one camera for object detection and depth estimation. Experimental results show that the MCA camera-based object tracking system can be used in various consumer surveillance systems.

articleTitle: Self-cancellation of multiple frequency offsets in OFDM systems
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a method to compensate the effects of multiple carrier frequency offsets for orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) systems when the received signals come from two spatially separated transmitters. The scheme estimates a proper compensation value with previously estimated carrier frequency offsets caused by the two transmitters. And then compensates the received time domain signal by using it, which results in self-cancellation of the interchannel interference should be introduced by frequency offsets<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>.

articleTitle: Personalized real-time location-tagged contents recommender system based on mobile social networks
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper proposes a real-time location-tagged contents recommender system which is based on mobile social network. The system locates a user via global positioning system, and then applies distance and preference filtering methods. We confirmed that the system is highly effective and applicable to convergence by a location data and content recommender through an implementation and preference prediction experiments.

articleTitle: Twinkling Buttons: Embedding optical feedback in textile buttons
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: Textile button is an essential component of electronic textiles. However, the absence of intrinsic feedback somewhat devalues its usability. In this paper, we propose a Twinkling Button controller, which provides hardware-embedded optical feedback without an additional output port. We have implemented a remote control cushion with sixteen Twinkle Buttons to demonstrate their usefulness.

articleTitle: Removing path switching overhead in multipath mobile video delivery
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: The pace at which more powerful portable wireless consumer devices such as smartphones and tablets have been adopted has not been matched by the ability of mobile networks to deliver high-quality video streams consistently to such nomadic users. In this work, we propose CMT-NEMO, a novel concurrent multipath transfer scheme for the delivery of scalable video content to users in multihomed mobile networks such as those expected to be found in public transport scenarios. Recent research in this context has shown that the single largest limiting factor for perceived quality is the overhead introduced by path switching operations in multihomed mobile networks. CMT-NEMO eliminates the need for path switching and, by removing the associated path switching latency, provides a substantial improvement of 5.9 dB on average in PSNR when compared with previously proposed schemes.

articleTitle: Quality-guided adaptivity for audiovisual content streaming by MPEG DASH
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: HTTP streaming has become a cost effective means for multimedia delivery nowadays. In this paper, we study the use of MPEG DASH standard to stream audiovisual content. Our focus is on a systematic approach for selecting the best audio and video alternatives. For that purpose, we extend the current standard syntax with quality related information.

articleTitle: Mobility management scheme for supporting legacy clients in IEEE 802.11s WMNs
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel mobility management scheme to support the mobility of legacy clients in wireless mesh networks. In order to provide compatibility with the IEEE 802.11s standard, methods for movement detection and new information propagation are implemented using primitives defined in the IEEE 802.11s proxy protocol. We verify that our proposed scheme achieves better throughput performance than the original IEEE 802.11s through a real test-bed.

articleTitle: Adaptive rate control scheme for cross-device handover in cloud based streaming system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In recent years, cloud services have been introduced to the multimedia streaming applications. The advantage of cloud-based streaming service is that users can access multimedia contents from any device that is connected to the Internet. However, it is not easy to guarantee seamless streaming when the display device is switched. To switch streaming service being provided from one device to another seamlessly, adaptive rate control scheme is required by considering the network and device capabilities. However, existing stream systems do not consider both the characteristics of display devices and network status for rate control. This paper proposes an adaptive rate control scheme to improve the performance of cross-device handover in cloud-based streaming service.

articleTitle: Overlay SNS: Next generation social network service
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: We propose a next generation social network framework that supports overlaid interaction and services to overcome information overload, privacy threat, and limited network/device handover. In this paper, main features and extended features of the proposed overlay social network service are introduced.

articleTitle: Tram location and route navigation system using smartphone
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: It is very important to reduce passenger waiting time at tram stops, when tram time tables are unknown by passengers. In order to accomplish that, we propose a tram location and route navigation system by using smartphones. The system is able to easily retrieve information about trams' locations by GPS, also providing users with the shortest walking route to the nearest tram station. For evaluating the usefulness of this system, we perform a demonstration experiment on an actual “Centrum” LRT system in the center of Toyama city.

articleTitle: EntWear: A durable smart jacket to control media devices
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In this paper, we developed a smart jacket using a drop & play interface to control media devices by using a touchpad embedded in the jacket. The inner circuit of the system is made by using transfer printing circuit technique to increase the durability of the system.

articleTitle: An energy efficient PAPR reduction technique for mobile terminals
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: An energy efficient PAPR reduction technique using adaptive clipping and filtering (CAF) for OFDM uplink transmission is proposed. Even though SC-FDMA is one of good choices for uplink transmission, there are several disadvantages which makes it less attractive to use in practical systems, such as high pilot overhead, link-level performance degradation, receiver complexity increment especially in MIMO mode, etc. There are various alternative PAPR reduction techniques to improve energy efficiency, and the CAF is the simplest and effective one, but oversampling and iteration requirements can be burdens. The proposed technique adaptively adjusts CR (Clipping Ratio) as a function of modulation, and has less burden of oversampling and iteration comparing with conventional Base Station (BS) CAF technique. Also, the effect of NI (Noise Interference) among users could be negligible owing to context-awareness and adaptive characteristics. Moreover it does not require receiver modification, thus improving energy efficiency of both BS and mobile terminals is possible. Simulation results show that the proposed technique presents excellent performance comparing with SC-FDMA.

articleTitle: Real-time adaptive advertising1 framework based on MPEG-21 for multi-screen IPTV environment
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper presents an advertising framework to ensure the targeted advertisement service for heterogeneous IPTV client devices with different capabilities and subscribers with different preferences by providing advertisement content selection and filtering mechanism in real time. To support adaptive advertisement service in multi-screen IPTV service environment, we suggest a new advertising framework using XML schema based on MPEG-21 DIDL (Digital Item Declaration Language).

articleTitle: Automatic generation system of the 3D character model for Smart TV contents production
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper presents a fully-automatic 3D character model generating system for Smart TV contents. The system applies 3D template model transferring and sweep animation technique for automatic rigging of the 3D character model.

articleTitle: The era of Cloud Computer thru bio-detecting and open-resources to achieve the Ubiquitous devices
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: Cloud computing service has become the newest application of the computer revolution. While many people still don't know much about the benefit of it, yet the techniques could be applied to one's life by bio-detection and open-software. Cloud-Computing helps provide the best efficiency for human beings, and it presents acquisition (user interface service), business (marketing driven usage), access (internet & intranet), and technology (unlimited, dynamic and flexible). For instance, the heart beat detection can be detected by the portable sensors which typically send the health information though the RFID, gather into the media gateway (mini-computer), and then upload it to the public server system. In a few seconds, the animated heart graphic with the calculated data soon replies back to the mobile computing gateway, displaying the 3D graphics of heart in order to prevent the heart stroke or monitor diseases. All this performance is going through the wireless radio frequency methodology, and its arithmetic process is finished by the remote computing servers that decrease the loading of mobile media devices. The tremendous value is the lowest cost for common users and the capability to provide the best medical care from the integration of the cyber system. Very much of product sense in the “Cloud Computer” will be the trend to compound the Bio- and Open-applications.

articleTitle: Efficient RFID service framework for seamless semantic interoperability
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper presents an efficient RFID service framework for supporting semantic consistency. The chief objective of our proposal is to let RFID applications exchange and share information about objects consistently and independently on various application fields. Our proposal enables seamless semantic interoperability and development of high-quality RFID services.

articleTitle: Implementation of sound-enhanced landscape album using environmental sound provisioning system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper presents an implementation of a location-based sound-enhanced landscape album. Users can enjoy scenery images in any designated location enhanced by environmental sound and a Life-like agent's comments. This system bases our environmental sound provisioning system, and newly proposes a hierarchical-structured sound composition scheme to achieve natural and inartificial sound. This system has been released to the public for smart-phone users<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>.

articleTitle: Remote control with switches on fingertips
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper describes a stand-alone household remote control. We previously proposed a glove input interface with switches on the fingertips, and added communication functions to the glove input interface. A prototype was prepared in order to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Program associated 3D Non-Real-Time service platform based on terrestrial DTV
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: One of the unresolved problems in providing viable stereoscopic 3D visual services based on terrestrial DTV is to carry additional video while maintaining existing 2D video quality within limited bandwidth. Mitigating this problem, our proposed 3D service incorporates ATSC Non-Real-Time (NRT) transmission scheme in which the additional video stream delivered in advance of use and stored for later consumption. At later time when transmitting an air AV program associating the additional video previously sent, a receiving device is able to play stereoscopic 3D video by combining real time video and the stored additional video synchronously. In this paper, we propose backward compatible system for the 3D NRT service and show that our implementation successfully presents the new stereoscopic 3D visual services based on Terrestrial DTV.

articleTitle: Vertical disparity correction of stereoscopic video using fast feature window matching
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: Conventional stereo rectification algorithms suffer from vertical parallax due to imperfect camera calibration. We propose a vertical disparity correction algorithm based on fast feature window matching. The algorithm yields vertical disparity less than 0.7 pixels.

articleTitle: Multimodal approach for stroke recognition using body-mounted sensors
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper presents multimodal stroke recognition algorithms using a magnetometer-aided inertial measurement unit (mIMU). At first, we devise a magnetometer-aided (mag-aided) algorithm based on two kinematic constraints. In addition, we propose hybrid algorithms composed of the mag-aided algorithm and the conventional gyro-aided algorithm. The hybrid algorithm outperforms respective algorithm (gyro-aided/mag-aided). Experimental results demonstrate high accuracy in stroke recognition rates.

articleTitle: Personal multimedia recommendation system on smartphone platform
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In this Paper, we propose a personal multimedia recommendation system for mobile devices. The proposed system automatically identifies the character of the user and recommends similar users to share multimedia contents.

articleTitle: Music relationship visualization based on melody transition using Conditional Divergence for music browsing system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper proposes music mapping considering melody transition for browsing system to visualize mood distances among tunes. Especially, we use the Melodies Markov model proposed to calculate Conditional Divergence and express music relationship on 2-D map applying two Multi-dimensional Scaling (MDS) methods.

articleTitle: Content authentication method for extended home multimedia and personal cloud services
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: For efficient and easy content sharing between consumer devices, various network technologies like Peer-to-Peer (P2P) and DLNA have been applied to content sharing services. Recently, as content-centric networking (CCN) comes into the spotlight as a future Internet architecture, CCN-based content sharing model like a virtual personal community service was newly introduced. One of the main characteristics of both P2P and CCN is to make it possible to retrieve contents host-independently by separating identity from location. Since such a characteristic also makes it possible that a content object can be delivered from unspecified devices/hosts with the replicas of the content object, receivers can't confirm the practical providers of the received content object. Hence, it is always a hot issue how to check the correctness and the integrity of a content object which is sent from the unknown devices/hosts. In this paper, we propose a content authentication method using bit-XOR operation in order that users can authenticate a content object transmitted through P2P/CCN. The performance analysis shows that the proposed scheme can reduce both computation and communication overheads so that it can be applied to mobile environments as well as home media services.

articleTitle: Dynamic connection and hybrid multicast screen protocol in virtualization system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: We implement the instant computing using virtualizatin system with Xen. In this system, user can make a computing environment using I/O devices nearby and the VM in the virtualization station. Remote I/O devices connect with the virtualization station automatically and can be choosen as I/O devices dynamically for instant computing. Users can see same screen data at multiple screen devices simultaneously in this system. In this paper, we propose the dynamic connection and hybrid multicast screen protocol in virtualization system.

articleTitle: Semantics-driven recommendation of coupons through Digital TV: Exploiting synergies with social networks
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: The well-known marketing strategy of distributing discount coupons can greatly benefit from Digital TV. Its interactive capabilities allow incorporating a recommender system to make such distribution personalized (based on each viewer's preferences), and also presenting the selected coupons attractively, related to the TV programs broadcast at any moment. In this paper, exploiting the possibilities that Web 2.0 offers, we propose a recommender system that goes one step further to increase coupon redemptions, by utilizing social networks as tools to add extra information to the system and reach new consumers.

articleTitle: A virtualization layer for mobile consumer devices to support demanding communication services in vehicular ad-hoc networks
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: The high mobility and variability of road traffic has hampered the design and deployment of automotive entertainment and information services through vehicular ad-hoc networks (VANETs). However, a scenario of greater predictability is looming in the near future, thanks to advances in such areas as automated transportation, fleet management and real-time traffic information systems, and also to the promotion of transport sharing policies. Having a priori knowledge about the vehicles' movements opens unprecedented opportunities for planning communication services. Knowing that, we present extensions for consumer devices to support demanding communication services through VANETs technology, relying on the concepts of virtual mobile nodes (VMNs) and virtual virtual circuits (VVCs).

articleTitle: Implementation of total variation regularization algorithm on CELL processor
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: The total variation (TV) regularization method is very effective and attractive for various image processing applications. The problem with the TV approach is the long computational time resulting from iterative calculations, which has been considered to be a major hurdle for its application to motion pictures. In this study, we have implemented the TV algorithm on the CELL processor by using various special programming techniques and an optimum software design.

articleTitle: Realistic IEEE 802.11e EDCA model for QoS-aware cloud service provisioning
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: Accurate and simple modeling of the real environment of IEEE 802.11 WLAN is essential for efficient provisioning of QoS-guaranteed multimedia provisioning. Several approaches have been proposed to increase the accuracy of EDCA analytical models. None of them, however, has considered the frame error probability of individual stations. In this paper, we propose a realistic IEEE 802.11e EDCA mathematical model for QoS-aware differentiated multimedia cloud services. The analytical model of EDCA is enhanced by considering the channel error probability at each station. We validate the accuracy of the enhanced model via experiments in a real testbed<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Design and realization of DVB-T/DVB-T2 dual mode receiver system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper implements study on receiver system design and realization of DVB-T and DVB-T2 digital terrestrial system. Dual receiver system realized here uses memory sharing technique to minimize system overload and suggests normal function result via Windows based S/W.

articleTitle: Configurable Active Star design for automobile FlexRay systems
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This investigation presents an Active Star (AS) design to receive data from one ECU (electronic control unit) node, and then transmit data to other ECU nodes in an in-vehicle network compliant with FlexRay physical layer standards. The AS is composed of several FlexRay Transceivers (FRTs), which are used to act as individual transceiver. The FRT at least comprises two major blocks in the physical layer design: Major Controller and Bus Driver (BD) used to transmit or receive data on the bus.

articleTitle: Hierarchical modulation scheme to assure environmental and adaptive receive rate of terrestrial 3D HDTV in SFN
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In this paper, we propose hierarchical modulation scheme to assure adaptive receive of terrestrial 3D HDTV in SFN. Proposed scheme assures adaptively that low SNR area receives minimum data rate and high SNR area receives maximum data rate. In addition, we can anticipate that data is received stably because of taking antenna array gain through MRC using multiple receive antennas.

articleTitle: Novel driving circuit with fast energy transfer speed and high efficiency for plasma televisions
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: A novel driver with low-cost and low-rating devices is presented for plasma display panels (PDPs), based on a compromise of high efficiency and fast energy transfer speed. Since the proposed driver has been designed by devices with half of voltage rating compared with the conventional drivers, it can take advantages of semiconductor devices with reduced conduction and switching losses as well as cheaper costs. The proposed driver configures the sustain circuit and the resonant circuit in such a way that the resonant network is energized by the sustain voltage level and the half sustain voltage level in charging and discharging the panel capacitor, respectively. Therefore, the proposed driver is designed for the purposed of fast voltage transition and high efficiency during the up-commutation and down-commutation periods, respectively. Moreover, the proposed driver is supplied from half of required sustain voltage level. The reduced supply voltage of the driver results in cost reduction and improved efficiency in the power supply blocks. As a result, the PDP driver presented in this paper can feature faster sustain voltage transition, higher brightness, high efficiency, and lower cost.

articleTitle: Fast mode decision algorithm for b-picture in full scalable video coding using coded block pattern
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: To provide network friendly scalability, scalable video coding (SVC) has been finalized as an H.264/AVC scalable extension. Because SVC supports a inter layer prediction scheme to determine the best coding mode in an enhancement layer, it achieves high coding efficiency but increases computational complexity. To reduce the computational complexity, we propose a fast and efficient mode decision scheme for enhancement layer using the coded block pattern for 16×16 mode of the current and previous pictures. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm reduces the processing time about 41.30% with negligible loss in coding efficiency.

articleTitle: Compressed sensing based ICI cancellation method for OFDM systems
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper presents an iterative inter-carrier interference (ICI) cancellation method using compressed sensing (CS) based channel estimation. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method can significantly improve the bit error rate (BER) performance for Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) systems in comparison with the conventional Least Square (LS) based methods.

articleTitle: Real time video stabilization with reduced temporal mismatch and low frame buffer
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper proposes a real time video stabilization method which only requires a low number of buffered frames. The effect of temporal mismatch between the original and deshaked frames to the black border artifacts is also considered. This mismatch effect is then removed by delaying the motion compensation with a suitable number of frames. To minimize the number of buffered frames, the deshaking filter is designed to have smallest filter delay. Simulation shows that the proposed stabilization filter effectively removes the shaky motions and has reduced black border artifacts.

articleTitle: Stereo depth video enhancement based on temporal and interview coherences
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: We propose a stereo depth video enhancement technique. Given stereo color video and its corresponding low-quality depth, we improve the quality of the depth video by increasing its spatial resolution and enforcing temporal and inter-view consistencies. Experimental results show that the proposed method provides high-quality stereo depth video.

articleTitle: ID-based key management scheme using threshold decryption for OPMD environment
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a key management scheme to protect contents in OPMD (One Person Multi Device) environment where a single user has multiple consumer devices. The proposed scheme using IBTD, a key management scheme that uses a user ID as a public key and the threshold decryption scheme that decrypts secret shares only if n the number of secret public values created by a contents server is more than t. Our proposed scheme enables users in OPMD environment to conveniently and easily use their contents through any of their multiple devices, and allows a contents server can manage keys efficiently in the user-centric key management way rather than in the device-centric key management way.

articleTitle: Pilot-based 2D-barcode image restoration using successive interference cancellation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: We present a new deblurring algorithm for binary images. The proposed algorithm uses a predefined (pilot) pattern to estimate the point spread function (PSF) and applies the minimum mean square error based successive interference cancellation (MMSE-SIC) technique to decide the binary pixel value of the image. Our simulation results show that the proposed MMSE-SIC performs far superior to the other known deblurring techniques.

articleTitle: Secure virtual personal cloud service based on CCN/VPC
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: Content-centric networking based virtual private community (CCN/VPC) has been proposed for easy and secure content sharing between members in extended home domains. In this paper, we further introduce a virtual personal cloud (vpCloud) service based on CCN/VPC, and propose more scalable and intuitive membership management including enrollment process and member list-based association. The proposed enrollment and association mechanism are optimally designed for distributed consumer environment, whereof the service provider support is not necessary. We also propose a revocation process which is included in the membership management.

articleTitle: An efficient bi-prediction algorithm for HEVC
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In this paper, an efficient bi-prediction algorithm to reduce encoding time of HEVC is proposed. HEVC is the next generation video codec under standardization. The proposed bi-prediction method is a kind of bi-prediction skip algorithm. The proposed method can find the favorable condition of bi-prediction compare to forward (list0) and backward (list1) prediction. Therefore, the bi-prediction is conducted under the favorable condition.

articleTitle: Real-time network-storage for digital cameras
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: Cloud computing suggests that we can move computers from the desktop onto the network. In this paper we investigate the potential to reduce local storage for handheld devices such as digital cameras or smart-phones to the minimum required to acquire and buffer images until they can be offloaded onto local network storage. The required minimum storage for video and digital still images are analyzed and tested in a practical home networking environment. Our results indicate that as local connectivity becomes faster and more ubiquitous that next generation devices could automate the entire upload, sort and store cycle for personal digital media such as pictures and video clips.

articleTitle: Moving object detection strategy for augmented-reality applications in a GPGPU by using CUDA
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: A spatial-color-based non-parametric background-foreground modeling strategy in a GPGPU by using CUDA is proposed. This strategy is suitable for augmented-reality applications, providing real-time high-quality results in a great variety of scenarios.

articleTitle: Stability-improved higher order delta-sigma modulator for Hi-Fi docking audio system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In this paper, stability improved higher order deltasigma modulator (DSM) with an additional noise transfer function (NTF) for stability compensation is proposed. The 7th order single-loop 1-bit DSM was designed and it achieves signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of 119 dB over 44.1kHz and 0.9 of maximum input level.

articleTitle: Real-Time LUT-based color correction for cell phone cameras in low light conditions without frame memory
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: Low ambient light conditions usually result in under exposed images for cell phone cameras. This paper proposes a LUT-based histogram matching method to correct the color tone of the under-exposed images. This method can be performed in real-time and does not need frame memory.

articleTitle: A visual object counter based on a multimodal data association for embedded systems with limited computational power
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: A low complex but highly-efficient object counter algorithm is presented that can be embedded in hardware with a low computational power. This is achieved by a novel soft-data association strategy that can handle multimodal distributions.

articleTitle: Wide color-gamut improvement with skin protection using content-based analysis for display systems
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an improved color-gamut method for Liquid Crystal Displays (LCD) with Multi-Phosphor White Light Emitting Diodes (MPW LED) and a modified rich color image processing method with skin protection. The human skin tone is typically memorized by color information. In order to increase the color saturation, the traditional rich color method makes skin color unnatural, so a modified rich color method with human skin colors protection is proposed. It has better quality than the traditional one. In mobile display systems, due to the limitation of bandwidth and memory capacity, how to realize the functions of rich color image processing method with skin protection on mobile display platform is an important issue. Moreover, we have implemented our proposed method in the FPGA and displayed the image on the ARM platform.

articleTitle: Temporal exposure inconsistency correction for CMOS captured video sequences
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: The paper proposes a novel method to correct the temporal inconsistency in exposure of video sequences captured from CMOS cameras. The temporal exposure consistency is improved by avoiding significant change in histogram over frames. This is done by histogram equalization where the target histogram is the temporal low-pass filtered result from the previous frames' histogram. Simulations on different video sequences verify the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Development of a self-adjusting lighting system based on the user density and mobility
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In this paper, we suggest the self-adjusting lighting system based on the user density and mobility (SALS) to reduce energy consumption in the office building. SALS classifies local areas into four classes according to the user density/mobility and provides an adaptive lighting service. SALS reduces the energy consumption of our test bed up to 47.8%.

articleTitle: Optimization algorithm for mobile robot paths in the presence of multiple obstacles
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper presents path planning optimization for mobile robots using approximate routes. The desired path connects a given starting position to a target position under avoidance of static obstacles. The described approach of path planning using approximate routes is based on the determination of suitable reference points as auxiliary positions. The auxiliary positions, together with the starting and target position, form a polygonal path as a collision-free-route. Obstacles are considered usually in an order depending on their distances from the starting position. According to this fact we obtain collision-free paths, which vary in their properties (overall length, number of the steering events and intensity of the steering events) depending on the location and the form of the obstacles. Therefore in the presence of multiple obstacles, we can generate all possible paths by using all permutations for the order of the obstacles. Then the best of these paths can be chosen with respect to some optimality criterion that takes into account the above-mentioned properties. The results of this method will be discussed based on Matlab simulations and an implementation as part of the development of a system for fully automated stock-keeping.

articleTitle: A low cost noise reduction technology for compressed video
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: A low cost noise reduction technology for compressed video such as the mosquito noise and the block noise has been developed. The authors characterized the length of filter taps for block and mosquito noise and proposed the memory sharing architecture for both types of noise detection. The architecture contributes the reduction of line memories required for buffering filtering data in a noise reduction pipeline.

articleTitle: Memory processing unit in video decoding system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: A memory processing unit that controls DDR-SDRAM data transfer of video decoding process is presented. Memory processor unit can support all the video standards and reduce memory bandwidth and overhead. Experimental results show that the decoding performance is enhanced about 20% than DSP only system.

articleTitle: Session-based watermarking in live IPTV environment
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: Protecting content, distributed over IPTV networks, from being illegally redistributed by legal subscribers requires methods beyond traditional conditional access and digital rights management systems. Adding watermarking techniques allows one to trace the user would an infringement have occurred. In this paper we describe a practical way to uniquely watermark content for each receiving device in a live IPTV environment. Special focus is given to finding a solution that fits into existing IPTV infrastructures.

articleTitle: Improvement of the spatial scalable video codec
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: The down-sampling method generally employs strong anti-aliasing for visual friendliness. However, scalable video coding reuse base layer representation for compression efficiency. The proposed method applies down-sampling method at the encoder, where strong anti-aliasing did not be considered. The adaptive filtering technique is exploited for reducing aliasing effect at the decoder. The experimental result with intra frame coding shows proposed method improves PSNR, and reduces bitrate.

articleTitle: An effective frame detection scheme for OFDM-based portable DRM plus receivers
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In OFDM based DRM Plus digital radio system, the difference between the transmitter and receiver oscillator frequencies causes the OFDM symbol timing in the receiver to drift which leads to performance degradation. In this paper, a frame detection scheme robust against OFDM symbol timing changes is proposed and evaluated.

articleTitle: Interacting with semantic musical features: Enhanced human-computer interactions based on musical “meaning”
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: Semantic musical features are proposed to reflect the understanding of the music, instead of the music itself, and serve as idea interfaces for musical “meaning” based human-computer interactions. The proposed semantic musical features are based on reductive music analysis and musical expressive features.

articleTitle: Seamless windowing for a future CE device running multiple operating systems
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper presents a seamless windowing architecture for a virtualized CE device on which operating systems run simultaneously. Our approach allows users to run applications on multiple software platforms as if on a single platform.

articleTitle: Selective area based depth estimation for three dimensional camera
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: Contrary to compute focus measure on fixed local area for depth estimation, we propose computing selective area using neighborhood around each center point in image sequence. Proposed method provides more accurate depth information and suppresses the noise effectively than conventional methods.

articleTitle: Virtual reproduction of spherical multichannel sound over 5.1 speaker system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: A virtual sound rendering is proposed that allows conventional 5.1 speaker system to reproduce spherical sound including vertical direction. The proposed algorithm is based on vector based amplitude panning (VBAP) and uses a perceptual model of human. The virtual spherical sound was compared with 5.1 sound and demonstrated significantly enhanced spatiality.

articleTitle: Energy saving potential of converged ICT and CE
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper presents the energy saving potential of converged ICT and CE based on a case study for Germany. A specific focus is on the issue of networked standby.

articleTitle: Enhancement of sensor network lifetime based on simple transmission power control technique
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: A simple transmission power control technique has been proposed and demonstrated to realize an energy efficient sensor network over existing CATV infrastructures. The sensor network has been implemented by using the wasted bandwidth of the coaxial cables of a conventional CATV network and supports automatic transmission power control to enhance the network lifetime. The transmission power control technique can enhance the lifetime of sensor network by a factor of 1.7 times with a 42% improved power saving efficiency.

articleTitle: High-precision 6-DOF motion tracking architecture with compact low-cost sensors for 3D manipulation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper presents a new 6 DOF motion tracking architecture which can be utilized in wide application area. Based on spatial IR intensity attenuation characteristics, 3D position and orientation of the device are estimated accurately in real-time, and its performance is more improved by inertial sensor fusion. The proposed system can be constructed with low-cost sensors, and it has advantageous architecture for downsizing without any deterioration of its performance.

articleTitle: Design of a low-power OFDM baseband receiver for wireless communications
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper presents a low-power OFDM baseband receiver for wireless communications. The proposed architecture employs low-power memories and resource sharing techniques, thus consuming less power than the existing works. Designed in 0.18μm CMOS technology, this receiver uses about 344K gates, and the power consumption is about 98mW.

articleTitle: Wearable network using Optical e-Textile Antenna for NLOS
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper proposes an Optical e-Textile Antenna (OTA) that overcomes line of sight (LOS) limitation of IrDA-based wearable network. Because the OTA can create a routing path for the optical signal among communication devices, that allows information exchange under the NLOS (non LOS) environment between receiver and transmitter. The proposed OTA is a piece of cloth made of e-Textile, it can be easily adapted to wearable network. The OTA either absorbs the optical signal in free-space at its maximum, close to its front-side, or emits the optical signal evenly. This paper verifies the performance of bi-directional communication of the proposed OTA with the prototype system.

articleTitle: Dynamic and interactive intelligent signage system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: Current digital signage generally displays static contents with limited user interactivity. In this paper, we present a dynamic and interactive intelligent signage system (DIISS) with two main contributions. First, we propose a mechanism to generate dynamic contents using a dynamic playlist. Second, a gesture-based mechanism is introduced to enhance user interactivity with the users' smart phones. Furthermore, a Gesture Application Program Interface (GAPI) is implemented over an Android platform. For the purpose of evaluation, two applications have been developed: the Dynamic Intelligent Advertising System (DIAS) and the Interactive Signage Photo Gallery (ISPG).

articleTitle: Real-time binaural noise reduction in diffuse noise field
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In this paper, we present a real-time noise reduction algorithm for binaural sound devices operating in diffuse noise fields. The diffuse noise PSD is estimated in a form of the minimum eigenvalue of the (2×2) input covariance matrix. To solve the under-estimation problem at low-frequencies, a compensation scheme is used. Also, to alleviate spectral bias due to smoothing, the estimated noise PSD is scaled by a smoothing factor. The proposed algorithm was implemented in real-time using a 16-bit programmable DSP core. Real-time implementation indicates that the algorithm requires less than 4MHz clock, so that it is suitable for wearable sound devices such as binaural hearing aids and headphones with noise reduction features.

articleTitle: Design of a breath detection system with remotely enhanced hand-computer interaction device
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In this paper we propose a real-time patient's breath detection system which is non-invasive and has low cost. It is constructed of a remotely enhanced hand-computer interaction device (REHCID) and a computer.

articleTitle: EASY Alliance: A new standard to enable access to consumer electronics and home appliances (CEHA) for seniors and the disabled
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: The population of the United States is aging rapidly, and many persons in the older population have disabilities that lower their quality of life. It is important to enable seniors, persons with various disabilities, and other classes of consumers to access easily the ever-more-complex user interfaces found in everyday consumer electronics and home appliances. We have established EASY Alliance in order to tackle this issue. By implementing technologies and methodologies suggested by EASY Alliance, manufacturers will be able to provide completely accessible devices without major design modifications or compromising device appearance. EASY Alliance will also provide testing and rating services. EASY Alliance, in partnership with consumer groups, will lobby the U.S. Congress to establish legal standards for the next generation of consumer electronics and home appliances.

articleTitle: A prefix-based smart search in Content-Centric Networking
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: Content-Centric Networking (CCN) enables content access and retrieval by its name for effective sharing. However, a user may not know the full exact CCN name of content to access, and thus likely encounters a daunting task of searching for the name. In this paper, we propose an efficient prefix-based CCN search protocol, which augments the basic CCN protocol. Using our protocol, users can access content easily without knowing its full CCN name. Moreover, the number of control packets for search operation can also be significantly reduced when compared with the similarity content search.

articleTitle: A secure application invocation mechanism in mobile phones for Near Field Communication
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper proposes an access control based, secure Near Field Communication in mobile phones. We make NFC tags hold codes of which the execution can make use of mobile services securely under user defined policies.

articleTitle: Efficient logging of metadata using NVRAM for NAND flash based file system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: The synchronous writing of metadata for flash file system generates excessive garbage. We propose the scheme for merging the writing of metadata so as to reduce the garbage of the NAND flash while ensuring file system consistency. The proposed scheme uses the non-volatile memory for synchronously logging modifications of the metadata. The last modified metadata can be recovered from a crash, after scanning logs in the non-volatile memory. The evaluation results show that the proposed scheme greatly reduced the overall application time and the number of written pages across various benchmarks, compared to the conventional flash file system.

articleTitle: Study of visual attention on multiple video sequences
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: As video technology advances rapidly, the need for simultaneous presentation of multiple videos is expected to increase in future. This paper utilized the orthogonal experiment to analyze visual effects of video physical features on multiple video sequences. The result shows that video position, human face, and motion attract attention effectively.

articleTitle: AndroScope for detailed performance study of the android platform and its applications
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper presents a performance analysis tool for the Android platform and its applications, called AndroScope, which collects performance data from both Dalvik VM and native libraries and provides GUI integrated with the Android SDK.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a mobile ambient intelligence based Mesoscale Weather Forecasting System
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This study aims at designing a forecasting system providing the predicted weather information based on the past weather data. Meanwhile, the augmented reality on the mobile device helps users obtain the weather around users' locations.

articleTitle: Chromatic aberration removal in narrow color regions of digital images
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: Chromatic aberration is a color artifact that should be removed in a color digital image. In this paper, the proposed method focuses on the detection and removal of the color artifact in narrow color regions caused by chromatic aberration. Absolute gradient values and gradient directions of RGB color components are used to detect transition regions, in which chromatic aberration occurs. Four gradient directions are used in order to improve the performance of chromatic aberration detection. Then, the chromatic aberration is removed using the color difference information. Experimental results show the effectiveness of the proposed chromatic aberration removal method.

articleTitle: A study of timing and frequency synchronization scheme in VSB systems for terrestrial 3D HDTV broadcasting
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In this paper, we study the performance of a synchronization scheme in VSB modulation systems for terrestrial 3-D HDTV broadcasting. The synchronization scheme consisted of the symbol timing recovery, the frame controlling and the carrier recovery. The proposed scheme shows a bit error rate (BER) performance that is almost the same as the ideal synchronization in VSB modulation systems.

articleTitle: Detection and localization of people in living room using a new background subtraction method
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: We propose a new block-based background subtraction and a sophisticated background update algorithm for illumination invariance and reliable performance. The proposed method is employed and verified for an air conditioner using an embedded hardware.

articleTitle: Collaborative IPTV content recommendation method using an implicit attribute preference
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper proposes a method using an implicit item attribute rating for a user. The method improves preference rating prediction accuracy of collaborative filtering-based IPTV content recommender systems by ameliorating the data sparsity problem. We confirmed that the method is robust in regards to the data sparsity problem found in collaborative filtering through various experiments.

articleTitle: The implementation of a shared bus architecture for Home Energy Controller
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: For the implementation of green home systems, it is important to control renewable energy generators like wind turbine or solar energy system. It is advantageous to use the PLC for maintaining compatibility with various power systems. In this paper, we present a programmable logic controller (PLC) with a design Multi-input Multi-output (MIMO) bus. The key advantages of proposed MIMO bus is expandable bus architecture and supports packet based data transfer. Proposed MIMO bus is consisted by event bus, data transmit bus and two wired serial bus. As a result, there is advantage in bus throughput compared to general system bus.

articleTitle: Uncompressed video transmission in portable devices for wireless video mirroring service
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: Wireless transmission of uncompressed video guarantees higher quality with lower latency than compressed video transmission. Although current wireless technologies cannot fully cover required data rates of about a few Gb/s for full high definition resolution, some wireless technologies such as ultra-wideband (UWB) provide 1 Gb/s data rate which is adequate for uncompressed video transmission in portable devices. In this paper, we propose an uncompressed video transmission system for wireless mirroring services in potable devices. We firstly simulated the performance of uncompressed video transmission using 1 Gb/s UWB technology. Then we implemented hardware-based uncompressed video processing block and Gb/s wireless MAC accelerator. Finally, we show the possibilities of uncompressed video transmission using single 1 Gb/s UWB physical layer (PHY) and extended transmission for more higher resolution using multiple UWB PHYs.

articleTitle: Interference to digital broadband communications and spread spectrum communications
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: Wireless transmission systems were initially noise limited and as they matured became interference limited. Now wireless systems are in transition from analog to digital. There are various classes of digital wireless systems: Those which require the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) to be above a positive SNR threshold, for example 3G and 4G (LTE) and Digital TV Systems. The other systems employ spread spectrum technology, using Direct Digital Synthesis (DDS) which operate with negative SNR, for example the Global Positioning System (USA), and similar systems: Galileo (Europe), Glonass (Russia), and Compass in China. Interference between 3G or 4G (LTE) digital signals to DDS based signals and interference from DTV signals to 3G or 4G signals is the subject of this paper. The measurement techniques that proved useful for analog transmission systems such as two-tone testing are not suitable for testing of broadband systems and their active components. These inadequacies will be discussed and alternatives proposed.

articleTitle: Advanced local fallback processing for motion-compensated frame rate up-conversion
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: We introduce an advanced local fallback algorithm that is sensible of an object boundary. In previous studies, local vector smoothness (LVS) was used to determine the local fallback ratio. However, LVS in a properly interpolated object boundary results in unnecessary motion. Our local fallback algorithm application is sensible of the moving object boundary and occlusion though spatial and temporal analysis of motion vector reliability.

articleTitle: iSense3D: A real-time viewpoint-aware 3D video synthesis system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In this paper, a real-time 3D video synthesis system is proposed. The system achieves more real 3D effect by dynamically adapts the synthesized view to user's viewpoint. There are two major parts: 6D viewpoint parameter extraction, and real-time Free-Viewpoint View Synthesis(FVVS). 6D viewpoint parameter extraction is done by 3D object tracking over image and depth. Various techniques for FVVS are proposed and implemented on GPU to achieve real-time. The system is demonstrated on multi-core system with programmable GPU. Real-time performance up to 1280×720p with 30fps is achieved.

articleTitle: Development of new data broadcasting service and verification platform using AT-DMB hierarchical feature
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: Advanced T-DMB has the hierarchical feature, compared with T-DMB. In the paper, we propose the new data broadcasting service using the hierarchical feature of AT-DMB. We also verify the proposed service by designing and implementing the reception verification platform. The test result presents the technical possibility of the proposed service.<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>

articleTitle: Panoramic interface for baseball live with SNS
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In this paper, a panoramic interface is proposed for immersive baseball live watch with various types of contents and social media on smart TVs and smartphones.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous constellation based QOSTBC for improving property of QRD-MLD
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: Orthogonal space-time block code (OSTBC) can achieve full diversity with a simple MLD, but the rate of OSTBC only achieves 3/4 of the maximum rate when applying more than two transmit antennas. To solve this problem, a quasi-orthogonal STBC (QOSTBC) scheme has been proposed. Even though a QOSTBC scheme can achieve the full rate, there are interference terms resulting from neighboring signals during detection. The existing QOSTBC using the pairs of transmitted symbols can be detected with two parallel MLD. Therefore, MLD based QOSTBC has higher complexity than OSTBC. To reduce the detection complexity, in this paper, we propose the heterogeneous constellation based QOSTBC for improving the detection property of QRD-MLD with maintaining a simple decoding structure.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of a stereoscopic video broadcasting system using repeated content
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a stereoscopic video broadcasting system using repeated-content. By using the repeated-content, the proposed system provides high quality stereoscopic video service and has full backward compatibility with legacy digital television service in the same channel capacity. In our experiment, we have verified the feasibility of the proposed system based on legacy broadcasting platforms.

articleTitle: Selective frequency decomposition in the wavelet domain for single image-based super-resolution
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper presents single-image based super-resolution (SR) algorithm using selective frequency decomposition in the wavelet domain. We synthesize the diagonal high-frequency (HH) sub-band of the discrete wavelet transform (DWT) using the low frequency component of the low-resolution (LR) image and the high frequency component of the bi-cubic interpolated image in the HH sub-band of the DWT. The reconstructed HR image is obtained by inverse wavelet transforming the synthesized HH sub-band together with the remaining three sub-bands. The HR image is further enhanced using directional edge sharpening. The proposed single-image based SR algorithm can be used to provide digital zoom or SR functions for consumer imaging devices such as mobile phone cameras, camcorders, and surveillance cameras. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm outperforms the existing single-image based SR algorithms in the sense of having reconstructed high-frequency components with minimum ringing artifacts.

articleTitle: Reliability assessment of LED backlight in mobile devices
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper studies the premature failures of LED backlights used in mobile devices that are subject to different use conditions since the life expectancy of an identical electronic component may differ substantially under different operating environments while traditional reliability assessment methods documented in many electronics handbooks failure to address this fundamental difference. The work outlines specific approaches in condition-based monitoring for optimal reliability in the display unit of mobile devices.

articleTitle: Automatic distinction of road surface conditions in road images at night-time using PCA and Mahalanobis weighting
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: The danger of causing serious traffic accidents at night-time is much higher than in the daytime. In this paper, we propose a distinction method of estimating road surface conditions by using only video information from a visible video camera. Compared to the conventional method, our innovative method provides the added benefit of the principal component analysis (PCA) of texture features and the reliability of the Mahalanobis distance. By using this method, it was possible to distinguish road surface conditions at night with high accuracy.

articleTitle: Key management scheme using secret sharing for multi-device based DRM
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a key management scheme in DRM which supports multi devices by using a secret sharing. The proposed scheme enables playing contents on registered devices only, and additional overheads are not occurring even if the number of registered devices are increased. We measured the overheads occurred by the proposed scheme through a prototype implementation, and showed that the scheme is applicable to consumer devices.

articleTitle: Directional adaptive hole filling for new view synthesis
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In this paper, a new hole filling method based on the direction of background image texture for new image view synthesis is presented. Strong texture gradient of background pixel is traced along its direction to obtain the texture orientation. Then texture direction map is computed for the hole pixels, based on the texture orientation. Finally, the hole pixels are filled by the background pixels along the direction guided by the texture direction map. This is to produce natural texture in the hole regions, while reducing blur, and preventing distortion in the foreground objects. Thus, high quality new image view can be achieved, even with large baseline synthesis. When the images are used for 3D viewing, the 3D effect is enhanced.

articleTitle: Image magnification by modifying DCT coefficients
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In this paper, we propose the method for magnification of a single image by modifying DCT coefficients. The proposed method modifies DCT coefficients using a reference map that indicates variations of pixel values according to the image magnification. Experimental results show that the performance of our method has been improved by 7% over the conventional methods.

articleTitle: Dual block truncation coding for overdriving of full HD LCD driver
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper presents an image coding method for overdriving of 10bit Full HD LCD display considering the chip size of TCON (Timing Controller) and real-time operation.
