The proposed method is an adaptive scheme of AM-BTC (Absolute Moment Block Truncation Coding). It splits a sample block into two sub blocks considering the color level distribution of the sample block and applies AM-BTC to each sub blocks. Experimental results show that the proposed method is superior to the conventional method in both objective and subjective visual quality.

articleTitle: Mobile-initiated with network-controlled IP flow mobility mechanism for multi-interface mobile node
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper proposes a mobile-initiated IP flow handover mechanism for Proxy Mobile IPv6, based on network-controlled mobility management architecture. The proposed mechanism enhances handover performances by enabling the simultaneous use of multi-interfaces during flow mobility.

articleTitle: A low complexity wavelet based depth map encoder for low bit rate 3D video applications
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: Depth maps, which aid the virtual view generation process in Depth Image Based Rendering (DIBR) applications in 3D video, are generally piecewise smooth images with sharp depth discontinuities. Compression artifacts that occur along the depth discontinuities often lead to poor quality of generated virtual views. In line with the importance of depth discontinuities towards view generation, we propose a non-uniform quantization method for wavelet based encoding of depth maps. Average rendering quality improvements of up to 0.8dB could be achieved.

articleTitle: An MB-OFDM UWB technology for wireless speaker systems
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: We present a multi-band orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (MB-OFDM) ultra-wideband (UWB) technology for a wireless speaker system which offers superior high-fidelity audio quality. The proposed scheme applies the Reed-Solomon code and the puncturer to payload data to improve the receiver sensitivity while maintaining the same data rate. Simulation result shows that the proposed scheme improves the signal-to-noise ratio of 0.8 dB at bit error rate of 10-6 when compared to the conventional scheme.

articleTitle: A single chip image processor for various in-car display equipments
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper presents a single chip image processor for various in-car equipments such as car navigation system, rear seat entertainment and rear camera display. There are four IPs<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*1</sup> to enhance image quality on the chip for the various in-car display products. The chip has a camera image compensation IP (four times more high-sensitivity, 50% noise reduction, distortion correction of 190-degree input field angle), a graphics rendering IP(draws 640Mpix/s), a high-quality image processing IP(super-resolution, NCM<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*2</sup>, dynamic gamma), an environment adaptation IP(brightness sensitivity, backlight control). We also developed an arbitrary frequency clock generation IP to generate frequency clock from 4.6 MHz to 162MHz on a small scale circuit. It is suitable for display of any format from QVGA to WXGA. In addition input-output video resolution, format, number of channel, external VRAM memory type and CPU interface are set flexibly depending on in-car equipment. The chip fabricated with 65nm 8-metal CMOS technology. Number of gates is 4.8Mgate and 4.1Mbit memory. Maximum operation frequency is 648MHz. Power consumption is 1.6W.

articleTitle: A new bit rate estimation scheme for a subclassified video content using hierarchical clustering in IPTV services
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In this paper, we present a new bit rate estimation scheme which determines a bit rate for each subclass in a sequence. A sequence is subclassified by hierarchical clustering using the parameter value extracted from each frame. The representative frame of each subclass is used to estimate the bit rate based on a statistical analysis and mathematical model. The proposed scheme can reduce the bit rate while maintaining the target quality in IPTV services.

articleTitle: Target speech detection based on microphone array using inter-channel phase differences
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper proposes a target speech detection algorithm with predefined direction of arrival (DOA). The target speech is detected based on the long term information of inter-channel phase differences (IPDs), including DOA and voice harmonic structures. This algorithm shows reliable performance in real applications.

articleTitle: High performance deinterlacing using spatially registered vertical-temporal filtering
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a high performance deinterlacing method using vertical-temporal filtering with spatial registration. The vertical-temporal filtering method performs compares favorably with existing deinterlacing methods with low computational complexity. However, it produces undesired artifacts in motion scenes since it assumes constant frame differences. By applying vertical-temporal filtering after spatial registration, we can reduce deinterlacing artifacts. To reduce computational complexity for the spatial registration, we use sub-sampled pixels. Experimental results show that the proposed method improves video quality in terms of subjective and objective evaluations.

articleTitle: Implementation of depth map filtering algorithms on mobile-specific platforms
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: The paper addresses the problem of implementing depth map filtering algorithms optimized for mobile platforms. Main algorithm being targeted is the bilateral filter and its implementation on a mobile platform1 has been studied. Furthermore, an alternative approach of using OpenCL to control a graphics accelerator<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> is explored. Experimental results of the latter look quite positive.

articleTitle: High-quality real-time temporal segmentation tool for video editing software
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: The increasing use of video editing software has resulted in a necessity for faster and more efficient editing tools. Here, we propose a lightweight high-quality video indexing tool that is suitable for video editing software.

articleTitle: Double edge trailing PWM based full digital audio amplifier design
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper presents double edge trailing PWM (DEPWM) based full digital audio amplifier design method. Several works about the design method of trailing edge PWM (TEPWM) or leading edge PWM (LEPWM) are reported previously but little work are reported on the design of the DEPWM based full digital audio amplifier. In this paper we derive mathematical equations about the DEPWM procedure in terms of the quantization noise reduction using the well-known sigma-delta digital to digital converter (DDC) and show the simulation result.

articleTitle: Photogrammetric approach fo1r precise correction of camera misalignment for 3D image generation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper proposes a new algorithm for correcting camera misalignments and removing Y-parallax between stereo images. Traditionally, this task has been tackled by estimating the fundamental matrix directly from tie points and applying epipolar resampling based on the fundamental matrix. We propose a photogrammetric approach for the task: Instead of direct estimation of the fundamental matrix, we estimate relative orientation between stereo images, calculating the fundamental matrix from the relative orientation and applying epipolar resampling. We compared the performance of the proposed algorithm with the traditional one. We found that the proposed one could generate epipolar resampled images with less distortions and could be more effective for 3D image generation.

articleTitle: In the cloud or near ourselves: The Future of consumer storage
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: Technological improvements such as virtualization, deduplication and advances in compression technology, as well as improvements in content security have reduced the costs while improving performance levels and trust in today's data centers. This, in addition to the growth in thin client devices such as smart phones and tablet computers, has led to increased use of digital storage in the cloud. At the same time the pending saturation of many internet and mobile networks, non-scaling content distribution networks, increasing content resolution and quantity and slow or intermittent internet connectivity for many users hinders the more widespread adoption of cloud based content. This talk will explore developments and drivers for both personal and Internet cloud storage and local storage in today's changing storage hierarchy and make projections on changes expected in the future enabled by more or less ubiquitous content and social interaction and ever smarter consumer and computer products.

articleTitle: Frameworks for real-time update type hazard map delivery
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: Hazard maps have been mainly made as a disaster mitigation measures for the earthquake and the tsunami on paper. However, they can express only a specific disaster scale and a damage situation on paper. We are constructing scalable real-time update type hazard map to distribute disaster information to a personal computer and the mobile phone. It become possible to correspond also to a snow disaster and a thunderbolt by always distributes latest information on the hazard map to information terminal. In this paper, we consider framework of real-time update type hazard map system.

articleTitle: Bare hands interaction with the projected images combined with a real object
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a bare hands recognition system which can be used in the projection environment and also can be used in both fixed and mobile systems. Particularly, for its robust and fast operation under the projected images, we designed structured infrared lights using diffraction gratings and a laser module. Performance measurements of the system and user tests were conducted.

articleTitle: Adaptive view-area and quality scaling for interactive free view-area tile-based multivision video
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: We have proposed so far a new multivision video provisioning scheme that enables numerous multiple users to access any view area with any desired resolution interactively and simultaneously. This paper proposes an adaptive view-area and quality scaling while preserving quick response for view-area movement. This can adaptively avoid redundant coding bits in conjunction with the movement of the viewing area. Simulation experiments and our implementation show the feasibility and effectiveness of our proposal.

articleTitle: Intelligent video co-processor for embedded DVR SoC
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: Most of embedded DVR systems have limited functions for intelligent video processing. In this paper, we propose architecture of an intelligent video processing system for embedded DVR systems. It consists of a conventional DVR host system and an intelligent video co-processor system. The co-processor system consists of an embedded processor and several primitive functional units for intelligent video processing, and can be connected to a host DVR system via an external bus interface. The proposed video processing system can perform video surveillance operations for four input video channels in real-time, and can provide a host DVR system with object information for further processing.

articleTitle: Privacy protected content sharing in extended home environment over Content-Centric Networking
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: Today, consumers possess a huge amount of personal contents due to increasing mobile devices and home appliances. This leads to extension of content sharing domain and thus, privacy protection of consumers becomes more important. In this paper, we propose a privacy protection mechanism providing the fine-grained access control on contents in the extended home environment. Our access control scheme is based on content encryption and supports a notion of groups and flexible access policy definition in content hierarchy using Access Control List (ACL). Though our proposed scheme is built on the hierarchical named content following CCN naming, it is also applicable to general hierarchies of named content or file systems as well.

articleTitle: Low-level feature selection for emotional music preferences based on subjective audience rating
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: Recently, many researches of modeling or measuring human feeling have been conducted to understand human emotions. However, researches on music-related human emotions have much difficulty due to the subjective perception of emotions. We have selected low-level musical features which may trigger human emotions, based on subjective audience ratings. This experiment is based on the subjective audience ratings of five hundred participants in a very popular Korean TV music program. In this program, audience is requested to rate music of the contestants and to select their preferred music based on their emotional feelings. The most relevant low-level features with respect to human emotions are selected by backward elimination method and experimental results show that selected low-level features touch human emotions quite positively.

articleTitle: New opportunities from ENERGY STAR “connected” appliances
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) has long encouraged implementation of “intelligent” energy-saving features for ENERGY STAR products. As an extension to this, EPA is now working with manufacturers to recognize new opportunities from “connected” smart grid enabled home appliances.

articleTitle: An enhanced frame transmission method for health devices with ultra low power operation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: The energy efficiency of wireless ultra low power communication method is important to increase operating time of a medical device. In this paper, we propose a continuous frame transmission (CFT) method that reduces the energy consumption through the control of retransmission of frames using carrier sensing in interference condition. Simulation results show that CFT has higher efficiency compared to TDMA based methods.

articleTitle: Digital tuner implementation using FM tuner for DRM plus receivers
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: The DRM Plus standard is being considered by many as a digital replacement of analog FM broadcasting. In this paper, an implementation of the DRM Plus tuner is described using the existing FM tuner and a digital signal processor (DSP). Performance of the proposed tuner is verified with satisfactory results.

articleTitle: A fine directional deinterlacing using virtual edge distribution
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: A fine directional deinterlacing using virtual edge distribution (FDVED) is presented. The proposed method can preserve delicate edges having various forms. From the subjective and objective perspective, experimental results demonstrate that FDVED outperforms the conventional deinterlacing methods.

articleTitle: Fast CAVLC level code skip scheme for H.264/AVC stream manipulation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: Fast scan and detection of the end of each CAVLC code is needed for bitstream operations like transcoding and manipulating. However, they need a larger computational load due to sequential and context-adaptive nature of CAVLC. That is why that it is dominant process in en entire decoding process. This paper proposes a fast skip scheme of CAVLC level code. Simulation results at the end of this paper show that the proposal about 70% reduction of CAVLC level code skip, and outperforms a conventional method.

articleTitle: Audio phase singularity detection for room acoustics parameter estimation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: An acoustical measurement method is presented for room acoustical parameter estimation. The proposed method collects the response of sinusoidal test signals and detects the audio phase singularity points as room acoustical features.

articleTitle: Seamless and secure P2P communication scheme for mobile Internet devices behind NAT
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a tunnel based peer-to-peer communication scheme which guarantees seamless and secure data exchange between mobile Internet devices behind network address translator. Since our approach allows of only the minimum delay to establish a safe communication channel between peers, it is well-suited to heterogeneous mobile network environment.

articleTitle: Reliable power line communication — A vehicle to smart home and smart energy
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: Power Line Communication or PLC - Using power line to connect and communicate is not new. But the data flowing over power lines connecting smart energy devices inside and outside homes imposes new challenges. Those devices include electrical meters (e-Meters or smart meters), distributed generators (wind, solar, heat+power), power switches, power plants, inverters, and distributed consumer electronics, sensing and monitoring devices. One of the most important requirements for the connectivity of those devices is high reliability. All the components need to be reliably connected all the time in any geographic location or environmental condition, and resilient to any interference. In this paper, we present several unique PLC architectures to achieve such highly reliable communications.

articleTitle: Enhancing multimedia performance of MIPS Android devices
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper evaluates the problem of inadequate multimedia performance of MIPS Android platforms. Methods for enhancement of multimedia performance are presented along with achieved objective and subjective results for VP8 decoder.

articleTitle: Speech synthesis for people with a visual impairment in digital television receivers
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: Based on the European digital television framework, DVB (Digital Video Broadcasting), this paper reviews different ways to integrate speech synthesis tools in digital television receivers and shows a system capable of extracting textual information from the broadcast multiplex, generating synthesized audio content in a computer and playing it back in the receiver. By selecting the suitable contents within the signalization data, the system adds acoustic information to the so-called text and graphic frames on screen. The purpose of this system is to make the program guide accessible for people with a visual impairment.

articleTitle: Interchannel interference cancellation for interleaved OFDMA systems
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an interchannel interference (ICI) cancellation scheme for interleaved orthogonal frequency division multiple access (OFDMA) uplink systems. In interleaved OFDMA, frequency offsets cause multiuser interference (MUI) as well as self-ICI, which result in severe performance degradation of the receiver. In the proposed method, after compensating a frequency offset in time domain, we eliminate the interference in frequency domain by using parallel interference cancellation (PIC). To reduce the computational complexity of the PIC, we only consider the interfering subcarriers at both sides near to the desired subcarrier. Simulation results show that the proposed method is very effective for interleaved OFDMA schemes and only five adjacent subcarriers are sufficient for ICI cancellation<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>.

articleTitle: Realization of surround audio by a quadraphonic headset
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In this work, a four-channel headset achieving the 5.1-channel-like hearing experience is presented. It includes a 5.1-to 4-channel down-mixer, head related transfer function, and artificial reverberation in a closed space. From experiments, the proposed headset achieves similar hearing perception as a 5.1-channel loudspeaker system with much lower hardware cost.

articleTitle: High-performance speech recognition for TVs with NLMS and beamforming
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: In order to remove TV noise effectively, a novel system, combination of single channel and multi-channel microphone-based noise reduction method, is proposed. A single channel filtering based on normalized least mean square is performed on each channel to reduce TV noise using a reference noise provided by TV speaker output. After that, as a post-processing, generalized sidelobe canceller attenuates more the remaining nonstationary noises in input speeches. For performance evaluation, a HMM-based speaker recognition rate is measured and the recognition rate showed remarkable improvement.

articleTitle: 3D image correction by Hilbert Huang decomposition
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
abstract: This paper presented a novel correction for 3D image signals by Hilbert Huang decomposition. Hilbert Huang decomposition is applied for dividing edges of the textures and edges of the objects. Depth map is corrected by regrouping pixels with edges of the objects. The proposed correction outperforms conventional methods especially at the boundaries of the objects.
